mechanism: Prednisolone may increase ivermectin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism and enhancing intestinal absorption; corticosteroids also suppress immune responses which may complicate parasitic infection treatment.
action: Monitor for ivermectin toxicity signs (neurotoxicity, tremors, ataxia); consider dose adjustment of ivermectin if on high-dose prednisolone; ensure adequate parasite clearance monitoring.
